- [AC Repair](https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca/services/ac-repair/): AC repair in Durham, Ontario. Central air, heat pumps, and mini-splits serviced for warm, humid Grey County summers. Free quotes.
- [Ductless AC Installation](https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca/services/ductless-ac-installation/): Ductless mini-split installation in Durham, Ontario. Cold-climate units for home offices, additions, and rural farm properties. Free quotes.
- [Heat Pump Repair & Installation](https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca/services/heat-pump-repair-installation/): Heat pump repair and installation in Durham, Ontario. Cold-climate units for village homes and rural farms moving off propane. Free quotes.
- [Thermostat Repair & Replacement](https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca/services/thermostat-repair-replacement/): Smart thermostat repair and replacement in Durham, Ontario. Install and setup for village and rural households through long Grey County winters. Free quotes.
- [Duct Cleaning](https://durhamontarioheatingcooling.ca/services/duct-cleaning/): Duct cleaning in Durham, Ontario. Full-run cleaning for century village homes, rural farmhouses, and new builds. Free quotes.
